member.name: T:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetryHost
member.summary: Owns the OpenTelemetry export pipeline for a DocumentAtom process. DocumentAtom domain, HTTP, MCP, SDK, and ingestion code emit through the BCL Meter/ActivitySource instruments declared in ; this host subscribes to those instruments by name and exports them over OTLP (and, optionally, an in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint). Instruments are no-ops until a host like this one subscribes, so the emit-side code carries no OpenTelemetry dependency. Dispose the host on shutdown to flush and release exporters.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetryHost.ServiceName
member.summary: Service name reported as the service.name resource attribute.

member.name: M:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetryHost.Start(DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings,System.String)
member.summary: Start the export pipeline for the supplied settings. Returns null when telemetry is disabled or settings are null, in which case the process emits nothing over the wire.
member.param: Service name to use when is not set.
member.returns: A started , or null when disabled.

member.name: M:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetryHost.Dispose
member.summary: Flush pending telemetry and release the export pipeline.

member.name: T:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings
member.summary: OpenTelemetry export settings. These settings control how the process exports the metrics and traces that DocumentAtom already emits through System.Diagnostics.Metrics.Meter and System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource. When is false the process emits nothing over the wire and instrument overhead remains near zero.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.Enable
member.summary: Enable OpenTelemetry export. Default is true. When false, no OTLP or Prometheus exporter is started and no telemetry leaves the process.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.ServiceName
member.summary: Logical service name reported as the service.name resource attribute. When null or empty the host supplies a default based on the component (for example "DocumentAtom.Server").

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.OtlpEndpoint
member.summary: OTLP exporter endpoint for both metrics and traces. Default is "http://localhost:4317" (gRPC). Use the collector's HTTP/protobuf port (4318) when is "http".

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.OtlpProtocol
member.summary: OTLP protocol. Valid values are "grpc" (default) and "http" (HTTP/protobuf).

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.OtlpHeaders
member.summary: Optional OTLP headers in "key1=value1,key2=value2" form, used to authenticate against hosted backends such as Grafana Cloud or Honeycomb. Default is null.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.OtlpTimeoutMs
member.summary: OTLP export timeout in milliseconds. Default is 10000. Minimum is 1000, maximum is 120000.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.MetricExportIntervalMs
member.summary: Metric export interval in milliseconds for the periodic OTLP metric reader. Default is 15000. Minimum is 1000, maximum is 300000.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.TracesSamplingRatio
member.summary: Trace sampling ratio applied by a parent-based, ratio sampler. Default is 1.0 (sample all). Minimum is 0.0, maximum is 1.0.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.EnablePrometheus
member.summary: Enable an in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint (an HttpListener) in addition to OTLP. Default is false. Useful when Prometheus scrapes the process directly instead of a collector.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusHostname
member.summary: Hostname for the in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint. Default is "localhost".

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusPort
member.summary: Port for the in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint. Default is 9464. Minimum is 1, maximum is 65535.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusPath
member.summary: Path for the in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint. Default is "/metrics".

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.EnableRuntimeMetrics
member.summary: Include .NET runtime metrics (GC, heap, thread pool, JIT) via OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Runtime. Default is true.

member.name: P:DocumentAtom.Telemetry.TelemetrySettings.EnableProcessMetrics
member.summary: Include process-level metrics (working set, uptime, thread count) as observable gauges. Default is true.
